forms.title: Forms & Inputs | QA Playground
forms.desc: Text fields, textarea, radio, checkbox, and select edge cases for automation practice.
forms.page_desc: Text inputs, textareas, radio groups, checkboxes, and selects — including validation, disabled and readonly states, indeterminate checkboxes, and multi-select. Submitting shows exactly what the form collected.

buttons.title: Buttons & Actions | QA Playground
buttons.desc: Enabled, disabled, delayed, and duplicate-label buttons plus click, double-click, right-click, and hover interactions.
buttons.page_desc: Every flavor of clickable control: a button that stays disabled until a condition is met, one that only appears after a delay, duplicate-label buttons that need scoped locators, and click/double-click/right-click/hover handlers.

tables.title: Tables | QA Playground
tables.desc: Static, sortable, filterable, paginated, and dynamically-editable tables.
tables.page_desc: A static reference table, a sortable/filterable dataset, a table you can add and remove rows from, and pagination — the four shapes of table you'll meet in real products.

frames.title: Frames & iFrames | QA Playground
frames.desc: Single iframe, nested iframes, and a lazily-loaded iframe for frame-switching practice.
frames.page_desc: Interacting with elements inside a frame requires switching context first. This page has a same-origin iframe, a nested iframe-in-an-iframe, and a frame that only loads after a delay.

dialogs.title: Dialogs & Modals | QA Playground
dialogs.desc: Native alert, confirm and prompt dialogs, a custom modal with focus trap, a tooltip, and a toast.
dialogs.page_desc: Native browser dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt) need dialog-event handling rather than DOM locators. This page also has an in-page modal with a focus trap, a hover tooltip, and a toast notification.

dynamic.title: Dynamic Content | QA Playground
dynamic.desc: Delayed rendering, polling counters, moving targets, disappearing elements, and covered elements.
dynamic.page_desc: Timing is where automation breaks. Elements here appear late, move around, get replaced with fresh DOM nodes, or start out covered by an overlay — practice waiting on the right condition instead of a fixed sleep.

dragdrop.title: Drag, Drop & Upload | QA Playground
dragdrop.desc: HTML5 drag-and-drop reordering, cross-list drag, sliders, file upload, and file download.
dragdrop.page_desc: Native HTML5 drag-and-drop for reordering and moving items between lists, a range slider, a file input with drag-and-drop upload, and a generated file download.

windows.title: Windows & Tabs | QA Playground
windows.desc: Links that open a new tab, a popup window, and window.opener messaging.
windows.page_desc: Multi-window flows need explicit context switching in automation. This page opens a new tab, opens a popup window, and receives a message back from the child window.

locators.title: Tricky Locators | QA Playground
locators.desc: Duplicate ids, hidden twins, dynamically-changing ids and classes, and a shadow DOM component.
locators.page_desc: Markup you'll actually meet in the wild: duplicate ids and classes, a visible/hidden pair with identical text, ids and classes that regenerate on every render, and a real shadow DOM component that normal CSS selectors can't pierce.

autosuggest.title: Autocomplete & Pickers | QA Playground
autosuggest.desc: Typeahead search, native datalist, a multi-value tag input, and a date picker.
autosuggest.page_desc: Async-feeling typeahead search with keyboard navigation, the native datalist element, a tag input that builds a list of values, and a native date picker.
